Messages.Author: laurent Barthet
Messages.Body:
Hi , i have some problem with how to you the master out of turn ROTSCHRECK.
When Vampire A attack Vampire B ( other player ) ,

vampire come to pre-strike step and vampire B use the card : Bone Spur
So vampire B can use his hand to make agraved domage.

Can Other player ( not involved in the combat ) use the master card
ROTSCHRECK on vampire A ?

Can the owner of the vampire B use the master Card ROTSCHRECK ?

i am supprised that a vampire with just protein can make an inner circle in
torpor just like this. :)

Thank all

Magus

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
laurent Barthet wrote:
> Hi , i have some problem with how to you the master out of turn ROTSCHRECK.
> When Vampire A attack Vampire B ( other player ) ,
>
> vampire come to pre-strike step and vampire B use the card : Bone Spur
> So vampire B can use his hand to make agraved domage.
>
> Can Other player ( not involved in the combat ) use the master card
> ROTSCHRECK on vampire A ?
>
> Can the owner of the vampire B use the master Card ROTSCHRECK ?

No.

But if the set-up went a little futher:

... and (after maneuvers, if any) range is set to close and then vampire B
declares his strike as "hands for 1 aggravated".

Then the answer is "Yes" for all Methuselahs except the Methuselah whose
turn it is.

> i am supprised that a vampire with just protein can make an inner circle in
> torpor just like this. :)

"Protean". The World of Darkness is full of surprises.
